title: 7 Signs a Godly Man Isn't Performing Anymore
caption:
7 signs a godly man isn't performing anymore.

He tells the story the same way twice. He'll hand you his phone and keep talking. The patience he shows a stranger doesn't disappear the second he's home.

None of that's about being caught. It's about there being nothing left to catch.

Proverbs 28:13 doesn't bless the edited version of a man. It blesses the confessed one.

#faith #integrity #christianmen #manofgod #character #godlymen
